images.title: Two lace pieces and a metre
images.purpose: Show the situation and the method cue: both lace pieces measured on a 1 m ruler marked in twentieths, ready to be added and compared with 1 m.
images.composition: One metre ruler along the bottom with wide margins, and two lace pieces on separate rows above it, both starting at 0.
images.exact_structure: Bottom: one straight metre ruler from 0 to 1 m with 21 evenly spaced tick marks, 20 equal gaps, drawn in grey #6B7280; taller ticks at 0 and 1 m, the 1 m tick in reddish purple #CC79A7. Above it, two flat lace strips on separate rows with a wide gap between them, both starting exactly at the 0 tick: the upper strip 8 gaps long filled teal #0072B2, the lower strip 15 gaps long filled amber #E69F00. Each strip a plain band with no lace pattern. Exactly 1 ruler, 21 ticks, 2 strips.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the two strips joined end to end, or any total or verdict written anywhere
images.takeaway: Measure both pieces in twentieths of a metre, then add and compare with 1 m.
images.description: A metre ruler in 20 equal gaps with two lace strips starting at 0: Geeta's 2/5 m and Shamim's 3/4 m; whether together they cover the 1 m border is left as a question.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to read each strip in twentieths of a metre and write 1 m in twentieths too.

image_decisions.why: A ruler in twentieths gives the common unit cue while leaving the sum and the verdict to the student.
